library_config.quality_changed_notice: Quality changed. Saving rescans the whole library and updates its covers.

ai_config.title: AI services
ai_config.desc: Providers and models belong to your account and are shared by all your libraries. Each library picks its models on the Libraries tab.
ai_config.api_key_keep: Saved ({hint}). Enter a new key to replace it.
ai_config.limits_hint: Limits are shared by all server instances. Processing that hits a limit is postponed without counting as a failure; a 429 pauses the provider for its Retry-After.
ai_config.provider_required: Provider name and Base URL are required
ai_config.models_empty: No models yet. Add one from the catalog.
ai_config.model_name_placeholder: Type or pick a model, e.g. gemini-3-flash
ai_config.catalog_search: Search models or type a model ID
ai_config.reasoning_hint: Higher levels describe more carefully but are slower and cost more.
ai_config.model_lookup_hint: Known models fill in their parameters automatically.
ai_config.model_lookup_text_only: {model} has no image input, so it can't describe images.
ai_config.model_lookup_unknown: This model isn't in the catalog. Please check the parameters below.
ai_config.rerank_hint: Cohere-style /rerank endpoint (vLLM, Jina, SiliconFlow, …). Each search reorders the top 50 fused results.
ai_config.probe_nothing: This definition claims nothing that can be tested.
ai_config.match_distance_hint: Cosine distance (0–2); lower is stricter and farther results are hidden. Takes effect immediately without re-embedding.
ai_config.dimension_hint: Only indexed dimensions are available; enable MRL for models whose native dimension is larger.
ai_config.image_formats_hint: Follow the provider's documentation. Covers are AVIF: when AVIF is selected the cover is sent as is; otherwise it is converted to JPEG or WebP.
ai_config.image_format_invalid: Enter a valid image MIME type, e.g. image/heic
ai_config.image_formats_required: Select at least one supported image format
ai_config.options_invalid: Advanced request options must be a JSON object
ai_config.bindings_desc: Pick which of your account's models this library uses for each role. After changing an embedding model, media must be processed again before semantic search can use it.
ai_config.language_hint: Language of image captions, tags and scenes; OCR text stays as written
ai_config.language_change_warning: Saving re-describes the whole library in the new language and updates its search documents and text vectors.
ai_config.language_change_confirm: Re-describe all {count} items in the new language? Every image is sent to the description model again, which takes time and incurs provider costs.
ai_config.bindings_saved_not_indexed: Saved, but indexing could not be started. Save again to retry.
ai_config.status_building: Switching to {model}: {ready}/{total}. Search keeps using the current model until it finishes.
ai_config.status_blocked_low_coverage: Not switched yet: the new model covers {ready} items, fewer than the current model. Retry to fill the gap.
ai_config.status_blocked_failures: Not switched yet: too many items failed with the new model. Check the model, then retry.
ai_config.status_retired: Previous model {model} is kept until {date}. Choose it again to switch back without reprocessing.
ai_config.status_issue: This model cannot be used, so the role is off: {message}
ai_config.status_issue_building: The model being switched to cannot be used: {message}
ai_config.role_no_options: No compatible models. Add one under AI Services first.
ai_config.role_describe_hint: Requires image input and structured output
ai_config.role_rerank_hint: Reorders the top 50 search results by relevance
ai_config.cap_structured_hint: Constrains output to a JSON schema; image description requires it.
ai_config.model_picker_desc: Known models are added in one click with their parameters filled in. Use the gear to adjust before adding.
ai_config.picker_check_first: Once the connection check passes, the models this provider actually serves are listed here too.
ai_config.picker_unknown: Not in the catalog; enter its parameters manually
ai_config.provider_connect_desc: Usually only the API key is needed; the address is preset for the service.
ai_config.api_key_toggle: Show or hide the API key
ai_config.models_desc: Choose them for each role in a library's settings.
ai_config.model_delete_desc: Libraries using this model lose that role binding.
ai_config.provider_delete_desc: Its {count} models are deleted too, and libraries using them lose those bindings.
ai_config.empty_desc: Add a provider such as OpenAI, Gemini or DashScope to enable image descriptions and semantic search for your libraries.

tags.title: Tag Management
tags.confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to permanently delete this tag? This will clear all existing associations and cannot be recovered!
tags.confirm_ignore: Are you sure you want to ignore this tag? This will clear all existing associations, and future imports of this tag will be automatically skipped!

tags.hex_placeholder: Hex or OKLCH color code (e.g. #6366f1, oklch(...))
tags.alias_card_description: Make the current tag #{name} an alias of another master tag. This only groups them at query time (searching for either will return items from both) without modifying database relations. The tag will be grouped under the master tag in the list.
tags.alias_card_disabled_tip: This tag already has child aliases. To maintain a flat structure, it cannot be made an alias itself.
tags.merge_card_description: Merge all relations of #{name} into another tag and permanently delete #{name} (without keeping it as an alias).
tags.aliases_help_text: Enter text aliases/synonyms. Future tag imports matching these values will be automatically mapped to this tag.
tags.confirm_merge_delete_prompt: Are you sure you want to merge #{source} into #{target} and permanently delete #{source}? This will transfer all post/media relations and cannot be undone!
tags.create_description: Create a new tag within this library's namespace.
tags.aliases_placeholder: Separated by commas, e.g. LP, Promo Page
tags.toast_alias_conflict: Tag alias conflicts with another tag or alias
tags.toast_merge_delete_failed: Failed to merge and delete tag
